title: The Cat at the Vet
lines: Meg has a cat. It is fat.
The cat has a cut on his leg.
The cat is mad. It hid.
Meg got the cat. It yips.
The vet is a big man.
The man pats the cat a lot.
The vet can fix the cut.
Meg hugs the cat. It naps.

questions.ask: Why did Meg take the cat to the vet?
questions.listenFor: The cat had a cut on his leg. It is in the second line. If they say "he was sick," ask them to find the word that tells us.

questions.ask: How do you know the cat did not want to go?
questions.listenFor: The cat was mad, the cat hid, and the cat yipped. Any one of those is a good answer - it is evidence, not a guess.

questions.ask: Do you think the cat will be scared next time? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: There is no right answer. You want a reason from the story - the vet patted him and fixed the cut, or the cat hated the whole trip.
